packageRules.description: Security fixes land immediately, outside the weekly window. This is the rule that would have caught the undici/react-router advisories that turned CI red (F-01).
Patch and dev-dependency bumps automerge once every CI lane is green; the suite is thorough enough to trust it.
Group the Python workspace so uv.lock is regenerated once, not per package — a split bump would fail `uv lock --check`.
Pin GitHub Actions to a commit SHA. Mutable action tags were the vector in the 2026 Trivy supply-chain incident; the release workflow already pins by hand.
Major upgrades to the runtime frame of the product get reviewed by a human, never automerged.
